findings.reason: as written the predicate drops every section-scoped gate hold, so a node implementing §8 verbatim fails one of its own done-when arms and the gate-held section dispatches early.
findings.text: §8 states "A request's own section is unheld when its plan is in the roadmap's ready set and the section is among that plan's ready sections (`ready_sections_by_plan` …)" and that "That set has every plan-level and section-level hold applied", but `ready_sections_by_plan[slug]` is built as `implementable_sections` minus `row["blocked_sections"]` (reckon/roadmap.py:3618-3633) and `blocked_sections` is populated only from section dependency blockers, mapped edges and section-scoped decisions (reckon/roadmap.py:3591-3611); `section_gate_blockers` is deliberately excluded there and lands only in `row["section_gate_blockers"]` (:3525) and `section_holds_by_plan` (:3650-3653). Reproduced against the tree: `split_unpassed_gates` on `{s1: implementable, s2: implementable}` with one open gate naming `s1` returns `plan_holding: []` and a section gate blocker naming `s1`, so the plan satisfies `is_ready` (only plan-level holds enter it, :3438-3448) while `s1` remains in `ready_sections_by_plan` — the waiter reads its own section as ready and launches, contradicting the done-when arm "a waiter on a section held by its plan's unpassed gate stays `awaiting-upstream` … when the gate names that section and leaves another implementable section unnamed". The claim "§8 reads no individual hold field" is what loses the gate hold.

findings.reason: the two candidate sources disagree exactly for the unheld plans the positive arms depend on, so the plan must name which one the shared assembly returns rather than describing a conditionally-attached field.
findings.text: §8 names `ready_sections_by_plan` as "the set the roadmap reports as ready sections", but that name is a module-local accumulator in `build_roadmap` (reckon/roadmap.py:2796, :3633) while the actually reported row field `row["ready_sections"]` is attached only inside the guard `if section_dependency_blockers or mapped_edges or decision_section_blockers` (reckon/roadmap.py:3591, :3606); a plan that carries no holds therefore reports no `ready_sections` key at all, whereas the local set is fully populated for it. A node told to read "the set the roadmap reports" can read the absent field and conclude no section of a clean plan is ready, which would hold the waiters that the done-when requires to go "straight to `queued`".
